name: nasa

subject.name: NASA
subject.audience: the public, contractors and staff who meet NASA's publications, signs and vehicles
subject.primaryJob: make one agency recognizable and legible across every field center and medium

principles: the grid organizes everything: the manual is built on it
sans-serif type with a clear hierarchy (N27)

territories.name: Mission control
territories.description: Engineering drawings and flush-left documents: a white field, one red mark and exact rules for each.

muse.name: the NASA logotype
muse.take: one even stroke, drawn on a grid (N05, N11)

signature.concept: one red on a white field
signature.reason: N11 draws the mark on a square grid, and on the laboratory territory every edge stays drafted, so red is the only thing that speaks

avoid: more than one signature color beside red (N07)

rationale.grounding.primary: Inferred, not stated by the source. The manual's date, grid and Helvetica fit the canon.
rationale.type.faces: Helvetica is named on N27, and Futura is an approved alternative on N28.
rationale.type.character.type-scale: modest steps between Light text and Medium headings (N27)
rationale.form.line: thin rules separate the manual's specimens (N27)
rationale.adaptivity: a white or light neutral ground (N07)
rationale.color.anchors.0: Sampled from the scan of N09, not a printed value; a 1976 swatch may have shifted.
rationale.color.anchors.1: Sampled from the scan of N09, not a printed value.
rationale.color.anchors.2: N07 specifies a white or light neutral ground.
